The '''''Heart of Artorias''''', originally '''''Tsam P'ah''''', was a [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[slaveship]] used to house captured sentients from [[Artorias]] and other planets. [[Nina Galfridian|Nina]] and [[Kaye Galfridian]], as well as [[Jenny (Artorias)|Jenny]] and [[Arbeloa]], were held on board.

==History==
[[File:Fleet_leaving_shramar.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] led task force during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] centered around the refugee ship ''Heart of Artorias''.]]
Its [[Commander/Legends|commander]] was [[Sha'kel]], until he was killed in a [[Revolt aboard the Tsam P'ah|revolt]] of the slaves,<ref name="I5">[[Invasion 5|''Invasion'' 5]]</ref> who took over the ship and renamed it the ''Heart of Artorias''. The ''Heart'' then became the rallying point of volunteers who wanted to aid in the evacuation of refugees from [[Shramar]] during the [[Battle of Shramar]].<ref name="I16" />
